EmailTemplate.subject: Thank you for your interest in the Environmental Life Sciences PhD at ASU
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
You recently requested some information on the Environmental Life Sciences PhD program at ASU. Please review this useful website; it will provide you with an overview of the program along with detailed information about how to apply.
To apply for the fall 2017 semester, we must receive your application between October 1 and December 15. Our priority deadline for the fall semester is December 1.
If you need further information or have any questions, please let me know.
Sincerely,
Wendi Simonson
Arizona State University | School of Life Sciences
